facts.text: §12 Risk Team can add requirements for “trading irregularities” or signs of inconsistency/gambling before approving payout; violations of risk parameters and undefined toxic activity “may result in forfeiture of profits and termination”.

§12 Customization requires trading until best-day ratio below target; 510Zero reward reduced to 10% if performance below 6%, or 8% for clients from Vietnam/Indonesia/Thailand. Reactivate Profit Sharing reduces next split to 20%, then gradually restores 50–90%.
§4 replication discretionary; rewards subject to internal policies and not guaranteed; distinguish admission/replication from earned entitlement.

Incorporated Prohibited Conduct §3.1 prohibits 'reputationally damaging language ... internally or externally, without a valid basis'; sanctions expressly include withdrawal denial and programme termination. Candidate B6 because firm assesses validity, not generic defamation boilerplate; Claude verify whether qualification narrows to objectively false statements.

facts.text: FAQ explicitly says 'Profit consistency does not apply to ... Challenge Phase 1 ... Challenge Funded Account'. Instant 20% best-day ratio; most lenient main challenge funded has no consistency, no firm-level penalty. Risk consistency is separate 1% trade-idea limit on Challenge/1 Phase, 2% Instant.

§29 absolute right to withdraw any trader at any time without explanation; no fee refund, no express cancellation of otherwise earned rewards. §10 recorded interview for lifetime reward above $1,000 at discretion, company holds exclusive publishing rights; no specific failure/payout sanction stated. §11.2 leverage can change; §11.3 daily/overall loss limits vary with market, experience, risk; §12 additional payout requirements may be imposed during account activity. Verify whether these change already-purchased contractual rules before B3.

§15 requires physical presence for AAA arbitration in Florida with Florida law; §28 exclusive Canadian courts and Canadian law. Contradictory internal dispute provisions, not FAQ/contract B4. §6.2 no monthly fee while §6.4 says billed every 30 days, another internal inconsistency.

Refund policy promises written acknowledgment/resolution of defective performance complaints generally within 30 days, termination if unresolved. Payout page has separate technical error claims within 7 days, response within 5 business days, compensation capped at fee. Not specific payout risk review/appeal.
